lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCu4Se4O8 (Mg2Cu8Se8O16) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cu in tetrahedral coordination by four O neighbors, Mg in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, and Se in a square-pyramidal environment with five O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Mg octahedra, as well as corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Se square pyramids, is observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
